lead.headline: Allgeier was out-run by his own backup — and AVIATO still lead by 46.7
lead.deck: Every starter is final at 122.6. Bok-aneers have only Kraft and Lloyd left tonight; ESPN gives AVIATO 99%.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Tyler Allgeier, started on the projection with Jeremiyah Love out, finished with 5.8 on 18 carries while Bam Knight ran 15 times for 80; Alvin Kamara scored 14.9 on your bench, so the flex call lost by 9.1. Josh Allen finished 18.3 against a 25.5 projection. None of it costs the week: Tuten (24.7), Likely (23.9) and Coker (15.7 on 13 targets) built a 122.6 to 75.94 lead, and Bok-aneers have only Tucker Kraft and MarShawn Lloyd left in Green Bay. Week 7 is the question now: Allen, Tuten and McLaurin are on bye, Love starts at quarterback, and the back who replaces Tuten is Tuesday's projection — with Knight's outing and possible injury now part of it.
